subject: CAIQ crosswalk & evidence bundle — Aureum Health onboarding
messages:
From: Priya Shah <security@aureumhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aureum Health Procurement <procurement@aureumhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: CAIQ control crosswalk & evidence for Redwood

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the conversation earlier. As part of Aureum Health's vendor onboarding we need a CAIQ (CSA) response crosswalk mapped to your internal artifacts and owners. For our security review please provide:

- A spreadsheet that maps CAIQ question IDs (we are focused on the CCM/CAIQ subset for data protection, identity, logging, and network controls) to Redwood's control names and evidence file names.
- A short owner name + email for each control/evidence item.
- Any SOC 2 report you can share (Type 2 preferred) and the major exceptions, if applicable.

Key items we will prioritize: encryption at rest/in transit, key management, privileged access, network segmentation, and logging/retention. Can you get a draft crosswalk and evidence bundle to us by EOD 2027-06-02?

If it helps, a short 30-min call with your security contact this week would speed things up.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Security Assessor — Aureum Health
security@aureumhealth.com

Attachment request: please reference file names rather than sending large binaries in email.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <security@aureumhealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-23T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ control crosswalk & evidence for Redwood

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear ask and timelines. I’ve looped in Olga (security/compliance lead) and Karthik (platform engineering) to own the crosswalk and evidence package. Proposed split of work:

- Olga: lead CAIQ mapping and attach the initial evidence bundle (SOC2 + diagrams + sample configs)
- Karthik: refresh network segmentation diagram and provide the infra ownership entries
- Me: coordinate approvals and confirm any redlines with procurement/finance

We’ll aim to deliver a draft spreadsheet and a ZIP of referenced artifacts by 2027-06-01 (one day ahead of your target) and can hold a 30-min review on 2027-06-02 if that works.

Next steps for you: confirm availability for a 30-min walkthrough on 2027-06-02 (I’ve tentatively penciled 11:00 AM PT).

Thanks — will keep this thread updated and attach the first draft shortly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <security@aureumhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Draft CAIQ crosswalk + evidence index (attached)

Hi Priya / Kim — attaching the draft crosswalk (Aureum_CAIQ-crosswalk-20270523.xlsx) and a small evidence bundle index. Highlights from the draft:

Sample mappings (excerpt):
- CAIQ ID: CCM-EN-01 -> Redwood Control: Data-at-Rest Encryption (AEK-Encrypted-Volumes) -> Evidence: SOC2-Type2-2024.pdf; encryption-key-rotation-policy.pdf -> Owner: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
- CAIQ ID: CCM-KM-02 -> Redwood Control: KMS-backed Key Management -> Evidence: key-management-architecture.md; KMS-access-roles.xlsx -> Owner: Security Team (olga_petrov@redwood.ai)
- CAIQ ID: CCM-ID-03 -> Redwood Control: Privileged Access Review -> Evidence: privileged-access-report-2027Q1.csv -> Owner: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
- CAIQ ID: CCM-NW-05 -> Redwood Control: Network Segmentation and VPC Controls -> Evidence: network-segmentation-diagram.svg -> Owner: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
- CAIQ ID: CCM-LOG-06 -> Redwood Control: Centralized Logging & Retention -> Evidence: logging-architecture.pdf; retention-policy.md -> Owner: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>

Open items and timeline:
- Network diagram needs an update to show dedicated customer VPC routing for Aureum — Karthik will provide the revised SVG by 2027-05-26.
- A few CAIQ questions require runbooks or redaction examples (we've noted them in the NOTES column of the spreadsheet).
- SOC2-Type2-2024.pdf attached; this is the attestation we typically share under NDA. If you need a bridge letter or an exception summary, we can produce a short memo.

Attachments included: Aureum_CAIQ-crosswalk-20270523.xlsx (spreadsheet), network-segmentation-diagram.svg (diagram), SOC2-Type2-2024.pdf (attestation).

If the format looks good, we’ll finalize the spreadsheet and expand evidence pointers to include shared Drive links.

Thanks — happy to discuss on the call next week.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

From: Priya Shah <security@aureumhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aureum Health Procurement <procurement@aureumhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft CAIQ crosswalk + evidence index (attached)

Thanks Olga — the draft looks good and the mapping format is exactly what our audit team needs. A few quick notes:

- We reviewed the sample mappings and confirmed that the SOC2-Type2-2024.pdf suffices for the attestation step. Please include a one-paragraph summary of any scope exclusions (if any).
- For network segmentation, the diagram is helpful but we need explicit callouts in the diagram to indicate customer-dedicated VPC boundaries and DNS filtering points. Karthik, can you add numbered callouts in the SVG?
- For privileged access, can you attach the latest quarterly review export (CSV) for Q1 2027? That will close out CCM-ID-03 on our side.

We’ll schedule procurement review this Friday; procurement@aureumhealth.com will follow up on contract redlines separately. Once we receive the updated diagram and the Q1 privileged-access CSV, we can mark the CAIQ as "complete" in our tracker.

Thanks again — opening calendar invite for 2027-06-02 11:00 AM PT to walk through the package.

Best,
Priya Shah
Security Assessor — Aureum Health
security@aureumhealth.com
